attempt_1.finding: Compact JSON call serialization was incompatible with the fixed normal-json whitespace expected when any_whitespace=false. This was a test serialization error and was corrected without changing the schema.

attempt_2.finding: Normal json.dumps spacing fixed the property-separator rejection. Four of six schema-positive cases completed, including finish, typed view range, multiline/quoted create, and the semantic-boundary execute_bash pipeline.

blocker: Under the actual strict xgrammar configuration, valid JSON escape sequences inside string fields carrying minLength constraints do not complete the compiled grammar. This affects execute_bash.command and str_replace_editor.old_str, so the required full function contract is not currently grammar-compatible.
not_weakened: No minLength, argument type, required property, variant, whitespace or strictness constraint was removed or changed.
